title: Ashley Bell
author: Dean Koontz
note: conf=0.88; ISBN 9780345545978 confirmed on Goodreads editions page as the Bantam ebook of Ashley Bell (Dec 8, 2015, 576 pp). Full title on title page is "Ashley Bell: A Novel"; canonical title is "Ashley Bell". Series: Koontz released two ebook-original prequel novellas, Last Light and Final Hour, explicitly marketed as "two standalone eBook original novellas leading in to Ashley Bell" (Penguin Random House / Apple Books). Goodreads groups them as the "Ashley Bell" series: Last Light #0.25, Final Hour #0.5, Ashley Bell #1 (Darkest Desires: The Makani Trilogy is the collected omnibus). So the novel is #1 in the Ashley Bell series; it is also self-contained and often shelved as a standalone Koontz novel.
